meta.title: Math board
meta.description: Express quantity ideas with kid-friendly patterns and named groups; students set their own level colours and share a board note with a file.

title: Math board
workspaceSubtitle: Place shapes · group them · name the amounts
tapToAdd: Tap to place, or drag one in
settingsIntro: You choose which patterns sit in the toolbox, what each stands for, and which colour marks which amount.
patternsHint: Tap a pattern to put it in the toolbox; tap again to tuck it away. Shapes already on the canvas stay.
settingsFutureDone: Saved. New shapes use the new value.
settingsExistingDone: Saved. Existing unmerged shapes also use the new value.
canvasEmpty: Pick a shape on the left to begin
canvasEmptyHint: Drag to arrange · box-select · Shift-click to add
gestureHint: Drag to arrange · box-select · Shift-click to add
groupedNoAlias: Shapes in a group share its name instead of having their own.
noSelection: Select one shape or box-select several to name, group, or merge them.
mergeReason: Merging needs the same shape, the same value, the same name, the same group, and a total that matches one of your levels.
hintGrouped: A whole group is selected: renaming changes the group.
hintSelected: Name, group or merge the selection.
hintEmpty: Drag shapes to arrange; drag on empty space to select several.
inspectorHint: Select shapes to name them here
noteHint: What do these shapes mean? How did you think about it?
clearQuestion: Clear the canvas? You can undo this.
inserted: Added the board note and file to the composer. Review it and send it yourself.
insertFailed: Cannot insert now. Wait until the composer is editable and try again.
summaryIntro: Here is what I put on the math board:
localDraft: Your draft stays here until you send it.
fileTooLarge: Choose a board JSON smaller than 256 KB.
storageError: Cannot save this browser draft. Save JSON to keep your work.
loadError: Cannot read the draft. Original data was not overwritten.
configApplied: Your spoken values and colours are now applied.
configGap: Settings history had a gap; retained changes were replayed with their original scopes.
configError: A settings update could not be applied; earlier successful changes were kept.
